$description: Social images: `safe` is [x0, y0, x1, y1], where the text must fit; `band` is the strip [y0, y1] the decoration is sized to (default: the whole height); `decorX` moves the decoration's centre (default: near the inline end). Social images: link-preview cards, profile covers and the avatar. This file is the source of truth. After changing any text, re-outline it (scripts/outline-text.py), then run `npm run build`. Every word drawn in an image must also be in its alt text; the build fails otherwise.

strings.$description: Text drawn in the images. An `accent` suffix (the headline's full stop) is drawn in amber, like the dot in the mark. Fonts are outlined to paths, so the images never depend on installed fonts.
